what: hir-expand src/change.rs ChangeWithProcMacros::apply: the crate-graph write (source_change.apply) ends in Db::maintain, whose nameres maintainer reads ProcMacros (proc_macro.rs:195 get_for_crate unwraps the singleton) before build_in sets the macros the same change carries. Every caller must call ProcMacros::init_default first (blaze-lower lib.rs:308, hir-expand fixture.rs:397, blaze-wasm-pack tests.rs), and even then the maintainer resolves once with no proc macros and again after build_in. Fix: apply the proc macros in the same batch as the graph (Db::batch, maintain once after both), or create the ProcMacros input inside apply before the graph write, so a change with a crate graph and proc macros needs nothing beforehand.
